reuse.why: All six month-wide actions use getBulkActionCategories, while tag parsing, spreadsheet access, budget writes and undo registration reuse existing helpers.

duplication.why: The repeated category queries are consolidated, although the new action repeats the income eligibility guard already present in the other actions.

placement.why: Category selection and spending calculations stay in budget/actions.ts, with handler registration in budget/app.ts and tag parsing delegated to shared/tags.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide policies, new action, handler registration and related tests.

maintainability.why: A focused shared selector makes future exclusion changes straightforward, though income eligibility remains distributed across the action implementations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every affected month-wide action calls getBulkActionCategories, and the new action uses the existing spreadsheet and budget mutation abstractions.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated category-selection queries are removed rather than reshaped, and the remaining repeated income guards are explicit.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkActionCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional hidden-filter exception; all six consumers continue through the shared selector.
